headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.

headlines.title: 研究报告预计：中国入境游未来10年或迎3万亿元市场增量
headlines.summary: 9月10日，中国商务部研究院国际服务贸易研究所在服贸会上发布《入境游促进消费的内在机理及增长潜力研究》，该报告在携程集团支持下完成，报告尤其关注中国入境游发展现状与特点。报告称，中国入境游已形成较好基础，有望迈入高质量发展新阶段，预计未来10年中国入境旅游收入占GDP比重有望提升至国际平均水平，这意味着约1万亿至3万亿元人民币的潜在市场增量。（环球时报）

headlines.title_en: Research report forecasts: China's inbound tourism may see a 3 trillion yuan market增量 over the next 10 years
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, the Institute of International Trade in Services of the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation under the Ministry of Commerce released the "Research on the Internal Mechanisms and Growth Potential of Inbound Tourism in Promoting Consumption" at the China International Fair for Trade in Services. The report, completed with the support of Trip.com Group, focused particularly on the current status and characteristics of China's inbound tourism development. The report stated that China's inbound tourism has already formed a solid foundation and is expected to enter a new stage of high-quality development. It is projected that in the next 10 years, the share of China's inbound tourism revenue in GDP is expected to rise to the international average level, implying a potential market increment of approximately RMB 1 trillion to 3 trillion. (Global Times)

headlines.title_en: The two-year U.S. Treasury real yield rose about 12.5 basis points on the day of the U.S. CPI inflation release; the two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose more than 25.9 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: In late New York trading on Friday (September 11), the yield on the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury note rose 0.43 basis points to 4.9669%. When U.S. CPI inflation data was released at 20:30 Beijing time, it was pushed up to 4.9792%, continuing to approach the October 23, 2023 peak of 5.0187%, then quickly dropped to 4.9016% by 21:03, marking a daily low. It showed a W-shaped trajectory throughout the day and rose 18.48 basis points for the week. The 2-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 3.98 basis points to 4.6254%, reaching 4.6551% when the CPI inflation report was released. It rose 25.93 basis points for the week, with gains accelerating on September 10.

headlines.title: 厄尔尼诺扰动供给，农产品期货价格升温
headlines.summary: 受厄尔尼诺影响，全球部分产区极端天气风险上升，部分农产品供给预期因此受到扰动。近期，从种植、种业到化肥、农药，A股农业产业链热度持续攀升，多种农产品期货价格走强。世界气象组织日前预计，本轮厄尔尼诺将在未来数月进一步增强。机构人士认为，天气扰动可能影响部分农产品供给，并向农资需求、替代品消费等环节传导。不过，各产区、各品种所受影响存在差异，行情能否延续，仍需观察减产预期与实际供需的变化。（中国证券报）

headlines.title_en: El Niño disrupts supply, agricultural futures prices heat up
headlines.summary_en: Affected by El Niño, the risk of extreme weather has risen in some global production areas, disrupting supply expectations for some agricultural products. Recently, from planting and seed breeding to fertilizers and pesticides, the A-share agricultural industry chain has continued to heat up, and prices of various agricultural futures have strengthened. The World Meteorological Organization recently forecast that this round of El Niño will further intensify in the coming months. Institutional analysts believe that weather disruptions may affect the supply of some agricultural products and transmit to areas such as demand for agricultural inputs and consumption of substitutes. However, the impact varies across production areas and varieties, and whether the rally can continue still depends on changes in production-reduction expectations and actual supply and demand. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 多只宽基ETF成交放量，市场调整中资金借道积极入市
headlines.summary: 9月11日，多只宽基ETF成交显著放量。过去一周（9月4日至9月10日），股票型ETF资金净流入超过百亿元，其中，宽基ETF成为“吸金”主力。站在当前时点，多位绩优基金经理表示，看好权益资产长期表现。展望后市，机构普遍持乐观态度。融通基金基金经理李进表示，在近期调整之后，现阶段市场整体估值相对较低，对后市持审慎乐观态度。其中，制造业红利叠加品牌力，成本比海外对手低，加上产品迭代速度、研发周期有极强优势，让一批出海标的公司显现出了足够韧性，海外市场份额不断提升。（上海证券报）

headlines.title_en: Trading volume of multiple broad-based ETFs surged, with funds actively entering the market amid the adjustment
headlines.summary_en: On September 11, trading volume in multiple broad-based ETFs increased significantly. Over the past week (September 4 to September 10), net inflows into equity ETFs exceeded RMB 10 billion, with broad-based ETFs becoming the main force attracting capital. At the current point, several high-performing fund managers expressed optimism about the long-term performance of equity assets. Looking ahead, institutions are generally optimistic. Li Jin, a fund manager at Rongtong Fund, said that after the recent adjustment, overall market valuations are relatively low at this stage, and he holds a cautiously optimistic view of the market outlook. Among them, the combination of manufacturing advantages and brand strength, lower costs than overseas competitors, and strong advantages in product iteration speed and R&D cycles have enabled a group of companies going global to show sufficient resilience, with their overseas market share continuously rising. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中方警告勿随意扩大苏丹制裁范围
headlines.summary: 中国常驻联合国代表团临时代办孙磊11日在安理会表决苏丹制裁问题决议草案后作解释性发言，警告不要随意扩大制裁范围。 孙磊说，考虑到安理会成员间分歧明显，执笔国美国提出对苏丹达尔富尔地区采取的制裁措施授权进行一个月的技术性延期，使大家有更充分时间讨论，中方对此不持异议，在表决中投了赞成票。中方一贯主张要确保决议草案的客观性、公正性和包容性，避免强推争议明显的案文。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: China warns against arbitrarily expanding the scope of Sudan sanctions
headlines.summary_en: Sun Lei, Charge d'Affaires of China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations, made an explanatory statement on September 11 after the Security Council voted on a draft resolution concerning Sudan sanctions, warning against arbitrarily expanding the scope of sanctions. Sun Lei said that given the obvious differences among Security Council members, the penholder the United States proposed a one-month technical extension of the authorization for sanctions measures against Sudan's Darfur region, allowing more time for discussion. China had no objection to this and voted in favor. China has consistently maintained that the draft resolution should be objective, fair and inclusive, and that controversial texts should not be forcefully pushed through. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 美联储9月加息概率超88%
headlines.summary: 【美联储9月加息概率超88%】当地时间9月11日，美国劳工统计局公布的数据显示，8月消费者价格指数（CPI）同比上涨3.4%，剔除食品和能源价格的8月核心CPI同比上涨2.4%，两份数据均符合市场预期。由于8月CPI数据没有表明美国通胀压力显著缓解，市场押注美联储下周议息会议加息25个基点的概率迅速攀升至超过88%。

headlines.title_en: Probability of a Fed rate hike in September exceeds 88%
headlines.summary_en: [Fed September rate hike probability exceeds 88%] On September 11 local time, data released by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics showed that the consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.4% year-on-year in August, while core CPI excluding food and energy prices rose 2.4% year-on-year in August. Both readings met market expectations. As the August CPI data did not indicate a significant easing of U.S. inflation pressure, market bets that the Fed will raise rates by 25 basis points at next week's policy meeting quickly climbed to more than 88%.

headlines.title: 工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红：加快算力标准体系建设指南编制
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部总工程师钟志红在2026中国算力大会上表示，算力已成为数据时代不可或缺的新型信息基础设施。“十五五”规划纲要明确提出，构建多层次算力设施体系和全国一体化算力网。

headlines.title_en: Zhong Zhihong, Chief Engineer of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology: Accelerate the drafting of guidelines for building the computing power standards system
headlines.summary_en: Zhong Zhihong, Chief Engineer of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said at the 2026 China Computing Power Conference that computing power has become an indispensable new type of information infrastructure in the data era. The outline of the 15th Five-Year Plan explicitly proposed building a multi-level computing power facility system and a nationwide integrated computing power network.
